# Alvaro Raditya Soewardono

Fullstack developer, robotics engineer, and cybersecurity specialist based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Automotive and Robotics Engineering student at BINUS ASO School of Engineering.

The site is a single-page SvelteKit portfolio at [alvaroswdn.my.id](https://alvaroswdn.my.id) with a hero/about section and a projects section. Built with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Locomotive Scroll for scroll animations.

## Education

- **BINUS ASO School of Engineering** — Automotive and Robotics Engineering (2024–Present)
- **Al-Izhar Pondok Labu Senior Highschool** — Natural Sciences (2021–2024)

## Experience

- **AeroBASE** — Head of Software Division (Feb 2025–Present). ROS2 and MAVSDK offboard control for autonomous drone navigation, real-time YOLO object detection on edge compute, vision-based pose estimation from monocular camera, team landing website.
- **BASE C.O.R.E.** — Head of Robotics Division (Sep 2025–Present). Research coordination in robotics.
- **Lucky Network** — Chief Security Officer (Feb 2021–Present). Java-based server management service with health-checking and load balancing, Go gRPC authentication system handling 1000+ concurrent players, network security hardening, automated payment gateway and donation platform.

## Skills

- **Programming:** TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, C++, Node.js
- **Frameworks & Protocols:** SvelteKit, Astro, Tailwind CSS, gRPC
- **Robotics:** ROS2 (Robot Operating System), MAVSDK, Computer Vision, Object Detection (YOLO), PID Control
- **Data:** MySQL, PostgreSQL
- **Systems:** System Administration, Database Administration, Cybersecurity

## Projects

- **[KRTI 2026](https://aerobase.id)** — Hexarotor with autonomous navigation using ROS2 and MAVSDK offboard control. Computer vision for the Kontes Robot Terbang Indonesia 2026 track.
- **[AeroBASE](https://aerobase.id)** — Drone control system (PID), team website built with Astro, documentation and tutorials for future team members.
- **[Lucky Network](https://www.luckynetwork.net/)** — Authentication system, infrastructure security hardening, donation and payment processing website.
- **[Insomnia](https://github.com/alvaroswdn)** — Java-based microservice for game server management and matchmaking, built with gRPC and MySQL.
- **[Mith](https://github.com/alvaroswdn)** — Go application for secure authentication of thousands of player accounts using gRPC and MySQL.
- **[Appeals](https://github.com/alvaroswdn)** — SvelteKit web application for submitting and reviewing punishment appeals, built with TailwindCSS and PostgreSQL.
- **[TerraTray](https://github.com/alvaroswdn)** — Web app-connected gantry system for automated plant seeding using PID control.
